info.name: Deema Fashion API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for all Deema Fashion backend API routes.

**Setup**
1. Import `Deema_Fashion_Local.postman_environment.json`
2. Set `base_url` (default: http://localhost:8000)
3. Run a login request to auto-save tokens

**Auth tokens (auto-saved on login)**
- `admin_token` ← POST /api/admin/auth/login
- `user_token` ← POST /api/user/auth/login
- `driver_token` ← POST /api/driver/auth/login

**Regenerate after route changes**
`php scripts/generate_postman_collection.php`
